_note: HOW TO UPDATE: Find the right tier below and add an entry to its "patrons" array, e.g. { "name": "TheirName", "note": "optional small label" }. A person can appear in more than one tier. Avatar colors, ordering, initials and counts are all handled automatically from each tier's "color" field and its position in this list — you only ever need to edit names. Set a tier's "hidden" field to true to keep it off the page. Supported colors: amber, violet, sky, emerald, slate.
